Build prompt

Build “PTA Fundraiser Raffle & Auction Bid Tracker” on NeoApps for a pta event organizer. Catalog items, record raffle entries and bids, close bidding at a set time and export an organizer tally. Use invitations and scope records to this group. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

An auction closed at 18:00 keeps the last eligible bid of $45. A later $50 bid cannot change the result.
